verdict.rationale: Highnote's GraphQL API and program-level spend rules let a policy be set once and applied uniformly across every card (highnote-docs-21), and cards can be issued programmatically per agent/workflow via API (highnote-docs-17), which gives some scale/automation capability, but there is no documented batch/bulk mutation, bulk query, or multi-item transaction endpoint for operating on many items in a single call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/query API or batch mutation documentation, evidence of bulk operations beyond program-level rule propagation.
